description: A plant manager must approve the changeover of Furnace 2 from Alloy X to Alloy Y and finalize the calibration, transition-material, and release controls before the next campaign begins.

shared_context.S1: Furnace 2 is scheduled to change from Alloy X to Alloy Y for the next production campaign.
shared_context.S2: The standard changeover procedure produces transition ingots that are normally evaluated for possible use or recycling.
shared_context.S3: Marisol must approve the changeover plan before Furnace 2 is released for the Alloy Y campaign.
shared_context.S4: The plant's pre-changeover routine requires the process engineer and maintenance lead to submit their formal current-findings reports through the recorded report-submission action; informal remarks do not count, and once both reports are recorded Marisol may settle without waiting for additional confirmations.

PF1.text: Evan received a customer amendment this morning stating that Alloy Y's first three ingots must undergo chemistry testing before release and that all transition ingots from this changeover must be recycled rather than shipped; the amendment is still awaiting entry into the production traveler.

PF2.text: Priya's inspection found that Furnace 2's oxygen analyzer calibration is overdue, and the analyzer must be recalibrated before the Alloy Y campaign; the calibration vendor confirmed that the work will take exactly 2 hours, but the maintenance ticket is still awaiting signoff.

acceptance_conditions: All transition ingots must be recycled.
Exactly the first three Alloy Y ingots must receive chemistry testing before release.
The oxygen analyzer must be recalibrated before the Alloy Y campaign.
The calibration plan must reserve exactly 2 hours of downtime.
A commitment must document chemistry testing and either entry into the production traveler or documentation of the customer amendment.
The customer amendment must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: any('chemistry testing' in c['detail'] and ('production traveler' in c['detail'] or 'customer amendment' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The customer amendment changes transition-ingot disposition to recycling, sets the first-release chemistry sample count to exactly 3, and requires a commitment linking chemistry testing to the customer amendment or its entry into the production traveler.
The overdue analyzer finding changes the plan from an ordinary changeover to mandatory recalibration before Alloy Y production with exactly 2 hours of downtime.
